form.div: The expense or bank transactions changed. Review the updated information before confirming again.
form.p: A company bank transaction may already cover this expense. Review the possible matches before posting to avoid recording the payment twice.
No possible company payment matches remain. You can continue posting with the current Paid by setting.

Posting without matching keeps the current Paid by setting and does not reconcile any bank transaction. To use a suggested payment, open the expenses, select Find bank transactions, then choose Use in Company payment match.

button.name: action_confirm_bank_match_posting
button.title: Post these expenses with their current payer setting through Odoo, without reconciling a bank transaction.
